title: Integral finite-Tor domain inclusion
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], and a scheme $W$. Let $D^b_{ctf}(W,\mathcal O_E)$ be the full category of bounded constructible derived-complete integral complexes having one finite Tor interval valid for all positive reductions [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude], and let $D^b_c(W,\mathcal O_E)$ be the bounded constructible derived-complete integral category [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed]. Define the canonical inclusion $D^b_{ctf}(W,\mathcal O_E)\to D^b_c(W,\mathcal O_E)$ by sending an object with its constructibility and uniform Tor witnesses to the same underlying derived object with its constructibility witness, and sending every morphism to the identical underlying derived morphism. The functor forgets the finite-Tor witness and performs no coefficient change, completion, or chosen equivalence.
